verses.original: Σὺ οὖν μου τέκνον ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Sy oun mou teknon endynamou en tē chariti tē en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: You therefore my child be strong in the grace that [is] in Christ Jesus

verses.original: καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρ’ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων παράθου ταῦτα πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις οἵτινες ἔσονται ἱκανοὶ διδάξαι ἑτέρους καὶ
verses.transliteration: kai ha ēkousas par’ emou dia pollōn martyrōn parathou tauta pistois anthrōpois hoitines esontai hikanoi didaxai heterous kai
verses.literal: And the things that you have heard vvv me [say] among many witnesses entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well

verses.original: Συνκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Synkakopathēson hōs kalos stratiōtēs Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: Join me in suffering like [a] good soldier of Christ Jesus

verses.original: στρατευόμενος οὐδεὶς ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις ἵνα ἀρέσῃ τῷ στρατολογήσαντι
verses.transliteration: strateuomenos oudeis empleketai tais tou biou pragmateiais hina aresē tō stratologēsanti
verses.literal: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in vvv [civilian] affairs in order to please the [one who] enlisted him

verses.original: δὲ καὶ ἐὰν τις ἀθλῇ οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ ἀθλήσῃ νομίμως
verses.transliteration: de kai ean tis athlē ou stephanoutai ean mē athlēsē nomimōs
verses.literal: Likewise . . . vvv a competitor vvv does not receive the crown unless . . . he competes according to the rules

verses.original: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον μεταλαμβάνειν τῶν καρπῶν
verses.transliteration: ton kopiōnta geōrgon dei prōton metalambanein tōn karpōn
verses.literal: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops

verses.original: νόει ὃ λέγω γάρ ὁ Κύριος δώσει σοι σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: noei ho legō gar ho Kyrios dōsei soi synesin en pasin
verses.literal: Consider what I am saying for the Lord will give you insight into all things

verses.original: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυίδ κατὰ μου τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneue Iēsoun Christon egēgermenon ek nekrōn ek spermatos Dauid kata mou to euangelion
verses.literal: Remember Jesus Christ raised from [the] dead vvv descended from David as proclaimed by my - gospel

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται
verses.transliteration: en hō kakopathō mechri desmōn hōs kakourgos alla ho logos tou Theou ou dedetai
verses.literal: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal But the word - of God vvv cannot be chained

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ὑπομένω πάντα διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς ἵνα αὐτοὶ καὶ τύχωσιν σωτηρίας τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ αἰωνίου δόξης
verses.transliteration: dia touto hypomenō panta dia tous eklektous hina autoi kai tychōsin sōtērias tēs en Christō Iēsou meta aiōniou doxēs
verses.literal: For this reason . . . I endure all things for the sake of the elect so that they too may obtain [the] salvation that [is] in Christ Jesus with eternal glory

verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος γὰρ Εἰ συναπεθάνομεν καὶ συζήσομεν
verses.transliteration: Pistos ho logos gar Ei synapethanomen kai syzēsomen
verses.literal: [This is a] trustworthy - saying - If we died [with Him] vvv we will also live [with Him]

verses.original: εἰ ὑπομένομεν καὶ συμβασιλεύσομεν εἰ ἀρνησόμεθα κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: ei hypomenomen kai symbasileusomen ei arnēsometha kakeinos arnēsetai hēmas
verses.literal: if we endure vvv we will also reign [with Him] if we deny [Him] vvv He will also deny us

verses.original: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν ἐκεῖνος μένει πιστὸς γὰρ οὐ δύναται ἀρνήσασθαι ἑαυτὸν
verses.transliteration: ei apistoumen ekeinos menei pistos gar ou dynatai arnēsasthai heauton
verses.literal: if we are faithless He remains faithful for vvv He cannot deny Himself

verses.original: ὑπομίμνῃσκε Ταῦτα διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μὴ λογομαχεῖν ἐπ’ χρήσιμον οὐδὲν ἐπὶ τῶν ἀκουόντων καταστροφῇ
verses.transliteration: hypomimnēske Tauta diamartyromenos enōpion tou Theou mē logomachein ep’ chrēsimon ouden epi tōn akouontōn katastrophē
verses.literal: Remind [ the believers ] of these things charging [them] before - God to avoid quarreling over words [which] succeeds only in {leading} the listeners to ruin

verses.original: Σπούδασον παραστῆσαι σεαυτὸν δόκιμον τῷ Θεῷ ἀνεπαίσχυντον ἐργάτην ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: Spoudason parastēsai seauton dokimon tō Theō anepaischynton ergatēn orthotomounta ton logon tēs alētheias
verses.literal: Make every effort to present yourself approved - to God [an] unashamed workman who accurately handles the word - of truth

verses.original: δὲ περιΐστασο Τὰς βεβήλους κενοφωνίας γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἀσεβείας
verses.transliteration: de periistaso Tas bebēlous kenophōnias gar prokopsousin epi pleion asebeias
verses.literal: But avoid - irreverent empty chatter [which] will [only] lead to more ungodliness

verses.original: καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ἕξει νομὴν ὡς γάγγραινα ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φιλητός
verses.transliteration: kai ho logos autōn hexei nomēn hōs gangraina hōn estin Hymenaios kai Philētos
verses.literal: and the talk of [such men] will spread like gangrene Among [them] are Hymenaeus and Philetus

verses.original: οἵτινες ἠστόχησαν περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγοντες τὴν ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν πίστιν τινων
verses.transliteration: hoitines ēstochēsan peri tēn alētheian legontes tēn anastasin ēdē gegonenai kai anatrepousin tēn pistin tinōn
verses.literal: who have deviated from the truth They say that the resurrection vvv has already occurred and they undermine the faith of some

verses.original: μέντοι τοῦ Θεοῦ Ὁ στερεὸς θεμέλιος ἕστηκεν ἔχων ταύτην τὴν σφραγῖδα Κύριος Ἔγνω τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ καί πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου Ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας
verses.transliteration: mentoi tou Theou Ho stereos themelios hestēken echōn tautēn tēn sphragida Kyrios Egnō tous ontas autou kai pas ho onomazōn to onoma Kyriou Apostētō apo adikias
verses.literal: Nevertheless vvv God’s - firm foundation stands bearing this - seal [The] Lord knows those who are His and Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity

verses.original: δὲ Ἐν μεγάλῃ οἰκίᾳ ἔστιν οὐκ μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν δὲ ἃ εἰς ἀτιμίαν
verses.transliteration: de En megalē oikia estin ouk monon skeuē chrysa kai argyra alla kai xylina kai ostrakina kai ha men eis timēn de ha eis atimian
verses.literal: - - A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver but also of wood and clay - Some indeed [are] for honorable [use] but others [are] for common [use]

verses.original: οὖν ἐὰν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν ἡγιασμένον εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ ἡτοιμασμένον εἰς πᾶν ἀγαθὸν ἔργον
verses.transliteration: oun ean tis ekkatharē heauton apo toutōn estai skeuos eis timēn hēgiasmenon euchrēston tō despotē hētoimasmenon eis pan agathon ergon
verses.literal: So if anyone cleanses himself of [what is unfit] he will be a vessel for honor sanctified useful to the Master [and] prepared for every good work

verses.original: δὲ φεῦγε νεωτερικὰς Τὰς ἐπιθυμίας δὲ δίωκε δικαιοσύνην πίστιν ἀγάπην εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν Κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας
verses.transliteration: de pheuge neōterikas Tas epithymias de diōke dikaiosynēn pistin agapēn eirēnēn meta tōn epikaloumenōn ton Kyrion ek katharas kardias
verses.literal: - Flee from youthful - passions and pursue righteousness faith love [and] peace together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart

verses.original: δὲ παραιτοῦ Τὰς μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσιν μάχας
verses.transliteration: de paraitou Tas mōras kai apaideutous zētēseis eidōs hoti gennōsin machas
verses.literal: But reject - foolish and ignorant speculation for you know that it breeds quarreling

verses.original: δὲ δοῦλον Κυρίου δεῖ οὐ μάχεσθαι ἀλλὰ εἶναι ἤπιον πρὸς πάντας διδακτικόν ἀνεξίκακον
verses.transliteration: de doulon Kyriou dei ou machesthai alla einai ēpion pros pantas didaktikon anexikakon
verses.literal: And a servant of [the] Lord must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone able to teach [and] forbearing

verses.original: ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους μή‿ ποτε ὁ Θεὸς δώῃ αὐτοῖς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: en prautēti paideuonta tous antidiatithemenous mē pote ho Theos dōē autois metanoian eis epignōsin alētheias
verses.literal: vvv [He must] gently reprove those who oppose [him] in the hope that . . . - God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of [the] truth

verses.original: καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς παγίδος τοῦ διαβόλου αὐτοῦ ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπ’ εἰς ἐκείνου τὸ θέλημα
verses.transliteration: kai ananēpsōsin ek tēs pagidos tou diabolou autou ezōgrēmenoi hyp’ eis ekeinou to thelēma
verses.literal: Then they will come to their senses [and escape] the snare of the devil [who] has taken them captive . . . to his - will
